import numpy as np

# Individual income tax receipts (in thousands of dollars) from 1929-1942
# From treasury_bulletin_1942_07_page_76.txt - "Individual" column
years = np.array([1929, 1930, 1931, 1932, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942])
receipts_thousands = np.array([1095541, 1146845, 833648, 427191, 352573, 419509, 527113, 674416, 1091741, 1286312, 1028834, 982017, 1417655, 3262800])

# Convert to billions (divide by 1,000,000)
receipts = receipts_thousands / 1000000

print("Data (year, receipts in billions):")
for y, r in zip(years, receipts):
    print(f"  {y}: {r:.6f}")

# Perform OLS regression
# Model: receipts = intercept + slope * year
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(years)), years])
coefficients = np.linalg.lstsq(X, receipts, rcond=None)[0]

intercept, slope = coefficients
print(f"\nOLS Regression:")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept:.6f}")
print(f"  Slope: {slope:.6f}")

# Project to year 2000
year_2000 = 2000
projected_2000 = intercept + slope * year_2000
print(f"\nProjected receipts for FY 2000: {projected_2000:.6f} billions")

# Actual FY 2000 net individual income tax receipts
# From treasury_bulletin_2001_12_page_17.txt - "Net" column for Income taxes (column 4): 1,004,461 million = 1004.461 billion
actual_2000 = 1004461 / 1000  # Convert from millions to billions
print(f"Actual receipts for FY 2000: {actual_2000:.6f} billions")

# Difference
difference = actual_2000 - projected_2000
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {difference:.6f} billions")
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(difference, 1)}")

EOF
